subject: general
question: If the diameter and the height of a cylinder are 10 cm and 10.5 cm, respectively, then using π = (22)/(7), find the volume of the cylinder.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** of a **cylinder** = π × r² × h

Given **Diameter** = 10 cm ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 5 cm

**Height (h)** = 10.5 cm

Volume = (22/7) × 5 × 5 × 10.5 = 22 × 25 × 1.5 = 825 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 825 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cad439f3431a8ff9ebf765a1dc616397c61dadb40125c406382e4a82a67caab.png] 

**Given:**

**Diameter (d)** = 10 cm

**Height (h)** = 10.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Volume** = πr²h, where r = d/2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (5)² × 10.5

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 25 × (21/2)

⇒ Volume = 11 × 25 × 3

⇒ Volume = 11 × 75

⇒ Volume = 825 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 825 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder

The area of the curved surface is given by the formula: CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The total area including the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of a Hollow Cylinder

If R is outer radius and r is inner radius: Volume = πh(R² − r²).</p
